title: The Configuration place
summary: Find the shared set-up of E1: data model, company library, catalogs, content packages, project settings and installation. The Projects pane starts on All projects, the company configuration every project follows; untick a project to hold it as it is, or click its name to see what it reads; drag the panes wider.
roles: Everyone may look; changes need the rights named in each section

title: Look up object classes
summary: See every kind of object with its attributes, shapes, relationships and where it may be placed.
roles: Everyone

title: Attributes and a project's pick lists
summary: Look up attribute definitions and give a text or choice attribute a project's own pick list.
roles: Everyone may look; editing a project's pick list: Project administrator

title: Shapes and their filters
summary: Look up the symbols E1 draws, with search and filters, ports, size and the classes using them.
roles: Everyone

title: Relationship types
summary: Look up the kinds of links between objects, their direction and where they show.
roles: Everyone

title: The company library: drafts, publishing and versions
summary: Add your organization's own attributes, classes and relationship types as drafts and publish them to every project.
roles: Owner or Library administrator (All projects); Project administrator (Only the ticked projects)

training.topic: Your own classes in the company library

title: Import attributes from a standard
summary: A standard's attribute dictionary as a spreadsheet becomes drafts of the company library, each keeping the standard's name and its code.
roles: Owner or Library administrator

title: Sheet templates
summary: Configuration → Sheet templates: E1's ISO and ANSI templates, and the company's and project's own, made in the designer (page, frame, title block cells bound to the document, revision block) and published.
roles: Configure documents for this project's templates; Edit the company library for the company's

title: Sign-off routes
summary: Configuration → Sign-off routes: E1's routes and the company's and project's own, made in the designer (the steps, who signs each, whom it must not be, the days to sign) and published; Project settings → Documents chooses one per purpose of issue.
roles: Configure documents for this project's routes; Edit the company library for the company's

title: Numbering schemes
summary: Configuration → Numbering: E1's revision schemes and the company's and project's own: phases with their series, start, digits, prefix and letters to skip, the version label, and the labels they give.
roles: Configure documents for this project's schemes; Edit the company library for the company's

title: Purposes of issue
summary: Configuration → Purposes of issue: E1's lists and the company's and project's own: each purpose's code, text, phase, watermark, whether it is from construction or makes the document void.
roles: Configure documents for this project's lists; Edit the company library for the company's

title: Filing rules
summary: Configuration → Filing: where an issued PDF is filed under Documents (folders from the document's number, name and attributes), where superseded PDFs go, and the file name, with an example.
roles: Configure documents for this project's rules; Edit the company library for the company's

title: Updates available and Check against projects
summary: See what in a project is on an older library version, and check which objects a draft would break before publishing.
roles: Check against projects: Owner or Library administrator

title: Upgrade objects to a new class version
summary: Preview and apply an upgrade of objects to a new class version in one undoable step; discard retired values.
roles: Lead engineer or above

title: Only the ticked projects: the project library
summary: Publish classes and attributes that only one project has.
roles: Project administrator

title: Convention templates for tag rules
summary: Publish tag rules as a template, apply it to a project and take over new versions when you choose.
roles: Publish: Owner or Library administrator; apply: Project administrator

title: Pin a project to a library version
summary: Keep a project on an earlier company library version, with a preview, by asking Alex (with its AI help).
roles: Project administrator

title: Catalogs of approved products
summary: Keep approved products with their data and vendor documents in versioned company or project catalogs.
roles: Owner, Library administrator or Catalog maintainer (company); Project administrator (project catalogs); everyone may read

title: Make an object from a catalog item
summary: Create an object filled with a catalog item's values and see which values differ from the catalog.
roles: Anyone who may create objects

title: Re-apply a catalog item, or detach from it
summary: Bring objects up to a new catalog item version while keeping hand-changed values, or end the link.
roles: Re-apply: may edit attributes; Detach: may edit the object

title: Content packages and standards
summary: See the content packages Core, Electrical foundation, Plant engineering, CFIHOS, NORSOK SCD, Specification, Wire harness and Marine, and which ones a project uses.
roles: Everyone may look; switching: Project administrator

title: Wire harness and Marine packages
summary: Switch on Wire harness for harnesses, wires, connectors, terminals, splices, bundles, protection and fixings, or Marine for fire zones, decks, cable transits and the deck and frame of equipment; both are off until a project switches them on.
roles: A Project administrator switches them on; anyone who may edit creates their objects

title: Partner content packages
summary: Install a content package a partner made and E1 reviewed and signed: it is installed for the organization, off in every project until the project switches it on, and refused when changed after E1's review.
roles: Publish the library (Administrator) installs and removes; Project administrator switches it on

title: Project settings: packages, drawing and tag rules
summary: Set a project's content packages, crossing-line style and tag rules, for one or several projects at once.
roles: Changing: Project administrator; looking: everyone in the project

title: Project defaults
summary: See the settings a new project starts with (read only for now).
roles: Everyone

title: Alex knowledge: your company's conventions
summary: Give Alex your company's standards, accept the conventions it proposes, and let it learn usual values from your projects.
roles: Engineering standards owner, Library administrator or Owner; accepting needs the permission to approve conventions

title: Datasheet layouts
summary: Find the datasheet layouts of the project, the company and the content packages, and open the designer.
roles: Project layouts: Lead engineer or above; company layouts: Owner or Library administrator

title: The model for Alex’s AI help
summary: See which model Alex gets help from in your installation, or whether none is set up or it runs locally.
roles: Everyone may look

training.topic: The model for Alex’s AI help

title: Storage
summary: Where the installation keeps its data (placeholder).
roles: Everyone

title: Rules: calculations, check rules and copy rules
summary: Calculate an attribute from the object's own values, its owners, related objects and the project with a rule: compose, map, calculate with units, choose, aggregate, format; published, its values follow their inputs and are never typed. A check rule gives a finding where its condition does not hold. A copy rule copies a value people may still change. Organization rules are made in the company library and reach a project when its library pin moves; content packages bring their own.
roles: Manage project rules (rule.manage): Project administrator; organization rules: Edit the company library, and Publish the company library to publish

title: Units of measurement
summary: The owner's unit table (101 unit groups), the project's unit system (MET, Imperial, SI) and company unit systems derived from them.
roles: Project administrator (the project's unit system); Library administrator (company unit systems)

title: Switching content packages on and off
summary: Switch a package on or off in a project: a package still in use is not switched off and E1 lists what uses it; a switched-off package's classes and shapes are not offered.
roles: Project administrator

title: Content package licensing and updates
summary: See which content packages your organization licenses and assign per-person packages; take a new version of E1's content packages into a project with a preview, never by itself.
roles: Organization administrator (assignments); everyone sees what is licensed

title: Catalog import
summary: Import a vendor list from Excel or CSV into a catalog: a dry run first, then drafts you publish in one step.
roles: Owner, Library administrator or Catalog maintainer (company catalogs); Project administrator (project catalogs)

title: Modules in the library
summary: Parts of P&IDs saved for placing again, kept in the company library, a project's or a content package: the list, search, details, Save as module? for groups drawn three times.
roles: Everyone may look; editing and publishing need the library rights

title: Module versions, withdraw and reinstate
summary: Publish a module draft as its next version, read its versions with change notes, withdraw it from placing and reinstate it.
roles: Publishing the company library, or Configure the project

title: Updating placed modules to a new version
summary: Update placed instances to a new module version: the module's changes written, each instance's kept, conflicts decided once per group; Update without conflicts.
roles: Changing the objects of the project

title: Editing a module: new versions
summary: Open a module's next version, change its details, members, tie-in points and parameters, upgrade its members and publish; duplicate a module or copy it to the company library.
roles: Editing the library the module is in
